pairs.subject: authorization
pairs.evidence: lib/produce/laneDoors.ts:298 The hosted and LOCAL_BINARIES=off postures are fixed for the life of the process, but every lane door is registered no matter which posture is on, so a class of work the posture says is absent stays addressable and is refused, if at all, by a runtime check inside the handler (laneDoors.ts:183 for sfx) instead of never being bound.

techniques.evidence: lib/produce/laneDoors.ts:183 The hosted capability block is a process-constant mode that removes a feature class (capabilities.ts HOSTED_CAPS). It is checked at launch time and only on the live sfx path. The image, video and Suno doors in the same table carry no posture check, and LANE_DOORS is built unconditionally, so a degraded deployment keeps its mutating surface. The rule 'state the mode in a read-only surface' is met (ABSENCE_REASON, describePosture, nearestCell).
lib/capabilities.ts:30 This context holds no request gate. Enforcement is stated to live in lib/apiAuth.ts and the Board decision upstream of LANE_DOORS, both outside this context.
lib/capabilities.ts:29 The capability matrix is declared not to be an authorization surface. No operation tiers are assigned here.

lib/gpu/lease.ts:365 Recycling an engine is a holder-only act. A stale or absent lease folds to no lease and is refused, and a fence mismatch is refused on the next line. PENDING_FACTS (capabilities.ts:186) also shuts a control until its fact is known.
lib/deployment.ts:104 LocalPosture has three values, all of them decided and none meaning 'unresolved', so collapsing it to one boolean folds no uncertain value.

lib/produce/laneDoors.ts:107 The originating Actor is carried as a typed value into the enqueued run (capture at enqueue). Whether the worker checks it at execute time is outside this context. Receipt reads use a synthetic operator actor but spend nothing.
lib/gpu/lease.ts:92 There is one machine-wide resource slot with no tenant or owner dimension. Holder identity is a fencing token, not a tenancy key.
lib/deploymentCells.ts:61 Cells name credentials and never issue or verify a machine secret. No issuer-side credential storage exists in this context.

pairs.registryProposal: unregistered-is-stronger-than-refused should say whether a deployment mode that removes a feature class for capability reasons (no GPU, no disk on a hosted plan) counts as an authorization dimension, or only modes motivated by permission. This code argues the matrix is 'not a security boundary', yet still leaves the operations addressable.
